commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' 2 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) was set free in the area by Fabio Silva and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
90+5' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) for a tough tackle.
90+1' Fabio Silva (Dortmund) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
89' Maximilian Beier (Dortmund) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his low drive to the right post is smartly dealt with by Moritz Nicolas.
88' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) sends a chip pass into the box, but Gregor Kobel is quickest to intercept the ball.
87' Dortmund keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. The ball is behind the touchline and Dortmund will take a throw-in.
84' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
82' That's the end of the game for Serhou Guirassy, who is replaced by Fabio Silva (Dortmund).
82' Niko Kovac has decided to make a change. Yan Couto (Dortmund) replaces Julian Ryerson.
81' B. Monchengladbach have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

81' Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the roof of the net. Gregor Kobel is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Philipp Sander trots off the pitch and is replaced by Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach).

77' The Dortmund players are exchanging some short passes.

73' PENALTY APPEAL by Dortmund, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
71' Niko Kovac has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) replacing Pascal Gross.
71' We are about to witness a substitution. Carney Chukwuemeka (Dortmund) is replacing Julian Brandt.
68' B. Monchengladbach control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

67' It looked like the long-range shot by Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
66' 58:42 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
66' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.

64' B. Monchengladbach keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
62' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
60' Niko Kovac has decided to substitute Karim Adeyemi and he is replaced by Maximilian Beier (Dortmund).
59' Sven Jablonski shows the yellow card to Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) for a heavy challenge.
59' Dortmund take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

58' What a wasted opportunity by Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the top of the net, but Moritz Nicolas makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
55' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
54' The ball goes behind for a corner. Dortmund will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
53' Emre Can (Dortmund) violates the laws of the game and is shown a yellow card by the referee, but it could have been a straight red as well.
51' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
48' Emre Can (Dortmund) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
47' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.

45' We will have 2 min. of added time.

40' Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.

40' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Gregor Kobel was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
39' Giovanni Reyna (B. Monchengladbach) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) and Felix Nmecha combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
37' The resulting corner from Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) comes to nothing.

34' A lofted cross from Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
32' Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
31' Neat passing move from Dortmund in order to create new attacking opportunities.
30' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Moritz Nicolas anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
29' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Julian Ryerson darts into free space to control the ball.
27' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
26' Emre Can (Dortmund) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
25' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
25' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund). The ball goes out for a corner. Dortmund can continue in their attacking effort.

24' B. Monchengladbach players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
21' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) tries to find Serhou Guirassy, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
20' A long pass, executed by Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund), missed the precision to reach his teammates. The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will take a throw-in.
19' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) was too forceful with his tackle and Sven Jablonski interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
17' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
16' Daniel Svensson (Dortmund) prepares to take a corner kick.
16' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Daniel Svensson with a fine lofted pass.

14' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Serhou Guirassy (Dortmund), whose header flies way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
14' A pass by Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
13' Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
12' Great teamplay by Dortmund as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
10' 1 - 0 Goal! Niklas Sule puts a cross into the box and finds Julian Brandt (Dortmund), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the right post. He makes it 1:0.
10' Felix Nmecha (Dortmund) and Karim Adeyemi attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
8' Gregor Kobel displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
7' Dortmund keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
6' Emre Can (Dortmund) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
5' The ball is cleared after Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) sends an accurate pass to Julian Ryerson, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
3' Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball has crossed the sideline. Dortmund are taking a throw-in.
3' Dortmund enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
1' Emre Can (Dortmund) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
